evidence: Arm ACLE c218a6b499897e70d88ceab7c6148d692541929f tools/intrinsic_db/advsimd.csv:1923 => DUP Vd.8H,rn
rows.finding: DUP replication is correct, but several kernels narrow int32 parameters (and negated int32 multipliers) to int16_t before the intrinsic. Out-of-range narrowing is implementation-defined, and unary minus of INT32_MIN is C undefined behavior; Lean currently uses modular BitVec conversion.
rows.next_action: Establish parameter bounds excluding INT32_MIN before negation and requiring int16 representability; test -32769,-32768,32767,32768 and INT32_MIN on the pinned compiler.

evidence: Arm ACLE c218a6b499897e70d88ceab7c6148d692541929f tools/intrinsic_db/advsimd.csv:1925 => DUP Vd.4S,rn
rows.finding: DUP replication is correct, but qs8/qu8 vadd form vright_shift with C expression -params->scalar.shift. For shift=INT32_MIN this is signed-overflow UB, whereas the Lean emitter performs modular BitVec negation; the external shift contract is still missing.
rows.next_action: Require shift in 0..31 (which also excludes INT32_MIN), add a frontend guard for unary-minus overflow assumptions, and test 0,1,31,32,INT32_MIN.

evidence: Arm ACLE c218a6b499897e70d88ceab7c6148d692541929f tools/intrinsic_db/advsimd.csv:1921 => DUP Vd.16B,rn
rows.finding: DUP itself is correctly modeled as replication, but s8-vclamp passes int32 min/max to an int8_t ACLE parameter. Lean models the target-style low-8-bit conversion; ISO C makes an out-of-range signed narrowing implementation-defined, and no min/max range contract is currently attached.
rows.next_action: Add caller/initializer contract -128<=min,max<=127 (and min<=max separately), plus compile-and-run boundary tests at -129,-128,127,128 for the pinned Clang target.
